name: Galson's Lode
summary: Galson's Lode is an iron mine nestled in the midwestern hills of the Arathi Highlands, located just outside Stromgarde Keep. Historically vital for supplying iron to the surrounding region, it sits directly adjacent to the mysterious Circle of Inner Binding.

sections.title: A Quarry Under the Shroud of War
sections.body: Positioned just northwest of Stromgarde Keep and right beside the ancient Circle of Inner Binding, Galson's Lode serves as an iron-rich mine in the rocky highlands. Like much of Arathi, the surrounding land is caught in bitter conflict between the ruined human kingdom, encroaching rival factions, and burrowing Drywhisker kobolds eager to claim rich mineral veins for themselves. Despite the chaos enveloping the highlands, the mine's wealth of raw ore remains an enduring temptation for anyone seeking to fortify their position in the region.

faq.answer: Galson's Lode lies in the midwestern reaches of the Arathi Highlands, nestled in the hills just northwest of Stromgarde Keep and adjacent to the Circle of Inner Binding.

faq.q: What is mined at Galson's Lode?
aliases: what ore is at galsons lode
faq.answer: The lode is a prime source of iron ore, making it an invaluable resource for weapon crafting, armor smithing, and local fortifications.
Drywhisker kobolds constantly infest the tunnels seeking to dig out precious ore, while rival factions in Arathi frequently fight over control of its iron reserves.

faq.q: What is the stone circle right outside the mine?
faq.answer: The stones standing right next to the mine entrance form the Circle of Inner Binding, an ancient magical site used to bind powerful elemental forces in the Arathi Highlands.

angles.text: The hills around Galson's Lode are renowned for dense veins of iron, attracting miners braving the perils of the highlands for raw ore.
Securing iron from local mines like Galson's Lode is essential for sustaining human resistance and rebuilding Stromgarde's shattered defenses.
